question:
B. Is this measure already running in Southwest Finland wellbeing services county (or in the Tyks university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital. Every patient whose cancer has not spread (stage I-III) is discussed by video with the university hospital lung team (surgeon, radiotherapy doctor, oncologist) before anyone decides against treatment that aims to cure. Today a county hospital can decide alone.
effect_summary_en: One before-after study from a single English district hospital (62 patients presented in a year) reports that the yearly resection rate rose by 30% after the video meetings started. It reports no curative share in percentage points.
supported_en: A 2004 study in the Journal of Telemedicine and Telecare reports that the resection rate rose by 30% after video team meetings began in Southend.
not_supported_en: The pages do not show a gain of 1.5 percentage points in the curative share, and they do not show the effect in a Finnish setting where a team meeting already runs.
in_use_quote: Kokouksessa on läsnä keuhkosairauksien erikoislääkäreitä sekä kirurgian, sädehoidon, patologian ja radiologian erikoislääkärit. Satasairaalan lääkärit osallistuvat kokouksiin etäyhteydellä.
missing_en: No page says that every stage I–III patient must be discussed before anyone decides against curative treatment.
summary_en: Tyks says on its lung cancer page that a team of specialists meets every week, including lung, surgery, radiotherapy, pathology and radiology doctors, and that Satasairaala doctors take part by video. The same page says not every cancer case needs to go to the meeting, so discussing every stage I–III patient is not shown as a rule. For the effect, a 2004 English before-after study reports a 30% rise in the resection rate after video meetings started.
unanswered_en: I found nothing saying whether Varha's own smaller hospitals send their stage I–III patients to the Tyks meeting.
